dasha_at_death.raw_text: Unfortunately the baby died on the same day at 11-40 a.m. during the VMD period of Venus-Rahu-Jupiter-Saturn-Venus. Venus denotes Moon (maraca). Rahu denotes Saturn (08-longevity). Jupiter is maraca and badhaka. Saturn is lagna cusp sub lord and 08th bhava lord.

author_observations.verbatim: In this case, Saturn is the sub lord of the cusps 01, 07 and 08. Saturn denotes 06th cusp through Mars. Rahu denotes 12th cusp through Venus, while Rahu is in the star of Saturn.
Hence 01, 06, 08, 12 along with badhaka and maraca are held by Saturn or its representatives. These combinations are really detrimental for the longevity.
Venus denotes Moon (maraca). Rahu denotes Saturn (08-longevity). Jupiter is maraca and badhaka. Saturn is lagna cusp sub lord and 08th bhava lord.
The child should have died at 11-39-15 a.m. when Lagna was in the star of Saturn in Cancer (Pushya) and sub of Saturn (01 and 08) too, as per the transit chart.
The combinations of the natal chart such as link of 01 and 08 with 07th and the dush sthaana linked, coupled with period at the time of birth caused the death immediately after birth.

rule_evaluation.notes: Saturn is both lagna CSL and 8th CSL — dual detrimental portfolio. This is the only case among Ch21-24 where a single planet holds both lagna and 8th cusp sub lordship.
